title: Kofta Berenji
subtitle: rice, sweet potato and herb balls in tomato sauce
description: Hedgehog-style balls of rice, mashed sweet potato, chickpea flour and herbs, simmered in a tomato sauce with dried plums and Persian lemons.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to its maximum temperature and line a tray with baking paper. Bake the whole unpeeled sweet potatoes for 20 to 30 minutes, until a knife slides easily into the centre. Peel and mash to a smooth puree.
Mix the puree with the uncooked rice, turmeric, 1 grated onion, chickpea flour, chilli, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper and chopped parsley and coriander to a sticky, even mixture.
Shape into balls about 4 cm wide, place on a tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
For the sauce, heat the olive oil in a pot, add 1 chopped onion and the sliced garlic and fry, stirring, for 5 minutes until golden. Add the tomato paste and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, boiling water, plums, broken Persian limes (seeds removed), 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring.

Arrange the balls in the sauce, cover and cook over low-medium heat for about half an hour, until the balls swell and look spiky like hedgehogs. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 more minutes to set.
